law_title: The Consumer Protection (Jurisdiction of the District Commission, the State Commission and the National Commission) Rules, 2021
exact_text:
(1) These rules may be called the Consumer Protection (Jurisdiction of the District Commission, the State Commission and the National Commission) Rules, 2021.
(2) They shall come into force on the date of their publication in the Official Gazette.
legal_status_notes: Published in Gazette of India Extraordinary, Part II, Sec 3(i) vide G.S.R. 912(E) on 30 December 2021.

law_title: The Consumer Protection (Jurisdiction of the District Commission, the State Commission and the National Commission) Rules, 2021
The Consumer Protection (Jurisdiction of the District Commission, the State Commission and the National Commission) Rules, 2021
exact_text: Subject to the other provisions of the Act, the District Commission shall have jurisdiction to entertain complaints where the value of the goods or services paid as consideration does not exceed fifty lakh rupees.
legal_status_notes: Enforced vide G.S.R. 912(E) on 30 December 2021. Operates under Section 34(1) proviso of CPA 2019. Replaced the statutory threshold of ₹1 Crore with ₹50 Lakhs (fifty lakh rupees).

law_title: The Consumer Protection (Jurisdiction of the District Commission, the State Commission and the National Commission) Rules, 2021
exact_text: Subject to the other provisions of the Act, the State Commission shall have jurisdiction to entertain complaints where the value of the goods or services paid as consideration exceeds fifty lakh rupees but does not exceed two crore rupees.
legal_status_notes: Enforced vide G.S.R. 912(E) on 30 December 2021. Operates under Section 47(1)(a)(i) proviso of CPA 2019. Replaced the statutory band of ₹1 Crore to ₹10 Crores with ₹50 Lakhs to ₹2 Crores.

law_title: The Consumer Protection (Jurisdiction of the District Commission, the State Commission and the National Commission) Rules, 2021
exact_text: Subject to the other provisions of the Act, the National Commission shall have jurisdiction to entertain complaints where the value of the goods or services paid as consideration exceeds two crore rupees.
legal_status_notes: Enforced vide G.S.R. 912(E) on 30 December 2021. Operates under Section 58(1)(a)(i) proviso of CPA 2019. Replaced the statutory threshold of 'exceeds ten crore rupees' with 'exceeds two crore rupees'.
